svg.title: Dense ANSI CPU flame summary: master
svg.desc: Actual call-tree hierarchy from sanitized native Time Profiler stacks. Widths are independently normalized CPU sample shares.
svg.text: Dense ANSI CPU flame summary: master
Actual native call-tree hierarchy, cropped at ansi_instruments_probe. Width = CPU sample share, not wall-clock speedup.
7,894 samples; independent normalization within this trace. Rectangles under 3 px are retained in ancestor widths but not drawn.
Source: sanitized collapsed native stacks (root-to-leaf). Outer Rust test-harness frames are cropped; no stack frames are inferred or fabricated.
Xcode 26.6 Time Profiler | 8s each | 200×50 dense fixture | oracle 276444 B / edfa0379543ed13d
